publication_date_rule: archive_date retains fields.created_at when present, otherwise CMS sys.createdAt, matching the official site card/date URL rule. These values are not automatically verified publication timestamps. published_at is populated only when an official RSS item explicitly supplies pubDate; it is null for all other records. publication_date_source preserves the original API date field, and publication_date_confidence states whether RSS verified publication time. lastmod remains the CMS sys.updatedAt timestamp, which can reflect migration or maintenance.

canonical_url_rule.rule: https://engineering.atspotify.com/{archive_date year}/{numeric archive_date month}/{fields.slug}, without a trailing slash; this is the public site getPostLink rule, independent of publication timestamp verification.
